setting: Setting: northwest Vietnam, 1954, a historical illustration with no blood and no gore. Vietnamese soldiers wear plain green uniforms, woven bamboo helmets covered with camouflage netting and rubber sandals; Vietnamese civilian porters wear brown or indigo peasant clothes and conical leaf hats; French soldiers wear 1950s khaki or camouflage uniforms with berets or steel helmets. Jungle-covered mountains, bamboo, mist.

scenes.d1: Dawn over a remote valley completely ringed by jungle-covered mountains, low mist on the valley floor, a small river; dozens of white parachutes with soldiers drifting down from propeller transport planes.
scenes.d2: A huge French fortified camp on a flat valley floor seen from a hill: sandbag bunkers, barbed wire, trenches, artillery guns, a few light tanks, an airstrip with propeller planes, a French tricolor flag, mountains all around.
scenes.d3: Inside a sandbagged command bunker: a confident French artillery colonel with a moustache pointing at a wall map with a stick, other French officers in khaki listening, a lamp and field telephones on a table.
scenes.d6: An endless line of Vietnamese civilian porters winding along a steep mountain pass at dawn: men and women with shoulder poles and baskets, and many bicycles loaded high with sacks of rice being pushed with bamboo poles; torches, mist, jungle.
scenes.d8: Night on a very steep jungle slope: dozens of Vietnamese soldiers in green uniforms hauling a heavy field howitzer uphill with long thick ropes, others wedging logs behind its wheels, torchlight, mud, determined faces.
scenes.d9: Night inside a simple bamboo-and-thatch command hut in the jungle: a thoughtful Vietnamese general in a plain khaki uniform sitting alone at a table with a large map and an oil lamp, one hand on his forehead, deep in thought.
scenes.d11: Dusk: Vietnamese artillery guns hidden in camouflaged dugouts on a mountainside firing down toward a valley fortress far below, bright muzzle flashes, puffs of smoke rising from the valley floor, orange sky.
scenes.d12: A valley floor covered with a spider web of zigzag trenches slowly closing around a sandbagged hill fort with barbed wire; in the foreground Vietnamese soldiers in bamboo helmets digging a trench with shovels and hoes.
scenes.d14: Heavy monsoon rain: tired Vietnamese soldiers in a flooded muddy trench, water up to their knees, sharing a small ball of rice under a rain cape, grey sky, barbed wire and a hill fort in the distance.
scenes.d15: Cross-section view of a hill: on top a sandbagged bunker with barbed wire, and underground a narrow tunnel being dug by Vietnamese soldiers with small lamps, passing wooden crates along the tunnel toward the centre of the hill.
scenes.d17: Afternoon: a Vietnamese soldier standing on the curved corrugated-steel roof of a sandbagged command bunker, waving a large red flag with a yellow star, other soldiers cheering around the bunker, smoke clearing over the valley.
scenes.d18: A long column of unarmed French soldiers walking out of a valley along a dirt road under a calm sky, tired faces, some with bandaged arms, watched by a few Vietnamese soldiers; mountains behind.
scenes.d19: 1954, a grand European conference hall: diplomats in dark suits from many countries seated around a very large table covered in green cloth, papers and microphones, tall windows with a lake and mountains outside.
scenes.d20: Present day: a green hill memorial site with a large grassy crater and preserved trenches, a restored sandbagged bunker with a curved steel roof, schoolchildren and tourists visiting, a red flag with a yellow star on a pole, a peaceful valley town behind.
